# eComet

> eComet (eComet Technologies) is a digital services team for businesses in the USA, Canada and Europe, covering web solutions, AI automation, growth marketing and digital support. The office is in Vehari, Pakistan.

The whole site is one page: https://teamecomet.com

## Services

- [Web Solutions](https://teamecomet.com/#services): modern, responsive websites and web applications built around the business's needs.
- [AI Automation](https://teamecomet.com/#services): workflows and integrations (for example Zapier, Make and n8n) that reduce repetitive work.
- [Growth Marketing](https://teamecomet.com/#services): campaigns, automation and email systems, including Meta ads.
- [Digital Support](https://teamecomet.com/#services): day-to-day support for digital tasks, including virtual assistance.

## How a project works

- [Process](https://teamecomet.com/#process): a short discovery call; the current process is documented, the scope agreed, and a fixed quote and timeline given; weekly check-ins during the build; hand-over, documentation and an optional care plan.
- [FAQ](https://teamecomet.com/#faq): short answers about services, pricing, updates and support.

## Contact

- [Contact form](https://teamecomet.com/#contact): replies within one business day; an NDA can be signed before details are shared.
- Email: hr@teamecomet.com
